text:
I need to find what day of the week it is 567 days after Saturday, September 19, 2009.

Since days of the week repeat every 7 days, I'll divide 567 by 7:

567 ÷ 7 = 81 remainder 0

Since 567 is exactly divisible by 7 (it equals 81 × 7), 567 days later falls on the same day of the week as the starting date.

**Saturday**
